examples.en: I'd like to take a day off next Friday to deal with some family stuff.
examples.zh: 我想下周五请一天假，处理点家里的事。

situation.en: Can I take a day off next Friday? Something came up at home.
situation.zh: 你想跟经理请下周五的假，怎么开口？

examples.en: We get twenty days of paid time off a year, plus public holidays.
examples.zh: 我们一年有二十天带薪休假，另外还有法定假日。

situation.en: How much paid time off do people usually take here?
situation.zh: 面试时你想问对方的休假政策，怎么问比较得体？

examples.en: I woke up with a fever, so I'm taking sick leave today.
examples.zh: 我醒来发烧了，所以今天请病假。

situation.en: Morning — I'm taking sick leave today. I have a fever and lost my voice.
situation.zh: 你早上起来嗓子哑了，想在群里说今天请病假。

examples.en: Please request time off in the system at least two weeks in advance.
examples.zh: 请至少提前两周在系统里申请休假。

situation.en: Just request time off in the portal, and your manager will get a notification.
situation.zh: 你想提醒新同事请假要走系统申请，怎么说？

examples.en: Let me check my leave balance before I plan the trip.
examples.zh: 我先看看还剩多少假期，再计划这次出行。

situation.en: Hi, could you tell me my current leave balance?
situation.zh: 你想知道自己今年还剩几天年假，去问 HR。

examples.en: Our vacation policy is use it or lose it, so take your days before December.
examples.zh: 我们的休假政策是不用就作废，所以十二月之前把假休掉吧。

situation.en: Remember, it's use it or lose it — book your remaining days before the year ends.
situation.zh: 年底了，你提醒同事年假再不休就作废了。

examples.en: After the weekend release, I took a day of time off in lieu.
examples.zh: 周末上线忙完之后，我调休了一天。

situation.en: I worked the weekend release — can I take Monday as time off in lieu?
situation.zh: 上周末你加班处理上线，想跟经理申请周一调休。

examples.en: My manager approved my request within an hour.
examples.zh: 我的经理一小时内就批准了我的申请。

situation.en: Yes, my manager approved my request this morning.
situation.zh: 同事问你假期批下来没有，你怎么回答？

examples.en: She's on parental leave until March and will be back part-time after that.
examples.zh: 她休育儿假到三月，之后先兼职回来。

situation.en: When is he back from parental leave?
situation.zh: 你听说同事要去休陪产假了，想确认他什么时候回来。

examples.en: The company offers three days of bereavement leave.
examples.zh: 公司提供三天丧假。

situation.en: I need to take bereavement leave this week — my grandfather passed away.
situation.zh: 你需要请丧假，在电话里跟经理说明情况。

examples.en: File an expense report within thirty days of the trip.
examples.zh: 在出差结束后三十天内提交报销单。

situation.en: I still need to file an expense report for the Singapore trip.
situation.zh: 出差回来一周了，你提醒自己别忘了什么？

examples.en: Reimbursement usually lands in your account within two weeks.
examples.zh: 报销款一般在两周内到账。

situation.en: How long does reimbursement usually take?
situation.zh: 财务说报销已经在走了，你想问大概多久到账。

examples.en: Keep the receipt for anything over twenty-five dollars.
examples.zh: 超过二十五美元的消费都要留好收据。

situation.en: Keep the receipt — you'll need it to claim the taxi fare back.
situation.zh: 你垫付了打车费，同事提醒你留好收据才能报销。

examples.en: I paid out of pocket for the hotel and claimed it back later.
examples.zh: 酒店是我先垫付的，后来报销回来了。

situation.en: Don't worry, I'll pay out of pocket and expense it later.
situation.zh: 公司卡刷不了，你跟同事说你先垫上。

examples.en: For flights and hotels, use the company credit card instead of your own.
examples.zh: 机票和酒店用公司信用卡付，别用你自己的。

situation.en: Should I book it on the company credit card?
situation.zh: 你第一次出差订酒店，不知道该刷哪张卡。

examples.en: The per diem covers meals and local transport.
examples.zh: 每日补贴涵盖餐饮和当地交通。

situation.en: Is dinner covered by the per diem, or do I expense it separately?
situation.zh: 你在看差旅政策，想确认吃饭的钱怎么算。

examples.en: Once the form is filled in, submit it for approval and your manager will be notified.
examples.zh: 表格填好后提交审批，你的经理会收到通知。

situation.en: The report is ready — I just need to submit it for approval.
situation.zh: 你填完报销表，下一步该做什么？

examples.en: I'm going on a business trip to Singapore next month.
examples.zh: 我下个月要去新加坡出差。

situation.en: I'll be on a business trip next week, so I may reply slowly.
situation.zh: 站会上你同步一下自己下周不在的原因。

examples.en: You'll get reimbursed once finance reviews the report.
examples.zh: 财务审核完报销单，你就会拿到报销了。

situation.en: Hi, when will I get reimbursed for the conference ticket?
situation.zh: 你垫的钱还没到账，去问财务进度。

examples.en: Send your invoice at the end of the month so we can process the payment.
examples.zh: 请在月底前发出你的账单，我们好走付款流程。

situation.en: I'll send my invoice on the last working day of the month.
situation.zh: 你是合同工，客户问你什么时候发账单。

entries.zh: 发票；给客户或公司的账单

examples.en: HR sent over the paperwork for me to sign this week.
examples.zh: HR 把需要我这周签的入职文书发过来了。

situation.en: I've signed all the paperwork and sent it back to HR.
situation.zh: 入职前 HR 让你把一堆文件签好寄回，你在邮件里确认。

examples.en: I signed the contract and returned it the same day.
examples.zh: 我签了合同，当天就寄回去了。

situation.en: I signed the contract this morning — you should have it now.
situation.zh: HR 在跟进你的合同进度，你怎么回复？

examples.en: The probation period is three months, with a review at the end.
examples.zh: 试用期是三个月，结束时有一次评估。

situation.en: How long is the probation period, and how is it evaluated?
situation.zh: 面试聊到最后，你想问试用期多久、怎么评估。

examples.en: Benefits enrollment happens during your first week.
examples.zh: 福利登记在你入职第一周内办。

situation.en: When is the deadline for benefits enrollment this year?
situation.zh: HR 提醒你别错过今年的福利登记窗口，你想确认截止日期。

examples.en: Does the plan include health insurance for remote employees?
examples.zh: 这个方案给远程员工提供健康保险吗？

situation.en: Could you tell me more about the health insurance for remote staff?
situation.zh: 你和 HR 确认远程岗位的福利，想问医保这一项。

examples.en: The company matches part of what you put into the retirement plan.
examples.zh: 你往退休金计划里存的钱，公司会按比例配一部分。

situation.en: How much does the company match on the retirement plan?
situation.zh: 你在看福利手册，想确认公司配缴的比例。

examples.en: Payroll set up direct deposit, so my salary lands on the last working day.
examples.zh: 财务设好了工资直存，我的工资在每月最后一个工作日到账。

situation.en: Please use this account for direct deposit.
situation.zh: 发薪方式要登记，你跟财务确认用哪个账户。

examples.en: The employee handbook spells out the leave policy in detail.
examples.zh: 员工手册里把休假政策写得很细。

situation.en: Check the employee handbook — the leave policy is in there.
situation.zh: 你不确定丧假有几天，同事让你去查哪里？

examples.en: They asked for an emergency contact during onboarding.
examples.zh: 入职时他们让留一个紧急联系人。

situation.en: For the emergency contact, can I put my partner's number?
situation.zh: 你填入职表格，看到要填紧急联系人这一栏，想确认填谁合适。

examples.en: My start date is the first Monday of next month.
examples.zh: 我的入职日期是下个月的第一个周一。

situation.en: Does a start date of the 6th work for you?
situation.zh: offer 谈妥了，你跟对方确认哪天开始上班。

examples.en: The company laptop arrived two days before my start date.
examples.zh: 公司配的笔记本在我入职前两天就到了。

situation.en: Will the company laptop be shipped to me, or do I buy my own?
situation.zh: 你入职前问 HR 电脑是会寄过来还是要自己买。

examples.en: If the VPN keeps dropping, raise a ticket with IT support.
examples.zh: 如果 VPN 老掉线，就给 IT 支持提个工单。

situation.en: My account is locked — I'll reach out to IT support.
situation.zh: 你账号被锁了，同事建议你找谁？

entries.zh: IT 支持、技术支持部门

examples.en: Raise a ticket and attach a screenshot of the error.
examples.zh: 提个工单，把报错截图附上。

situation.en: Could you raise a ticket for the broken dock? IT will pick it up.
situation.zh: 你想让新同事自己走工单流程反馈设备问题，怎么说？

examples.en: I still don't have access permissions for the billing repo.
examples.zh: 我还是没有计费仓库的访问权限。

situation.en: I can't open the repo — could you check my access permissions?
situation.zh: 入职第二天你发现自己进不去代码仓库，跟 IT 说明。

examples.en: You can order equipment up to five hundred dollars without extra approval.
examples.zh: 五百美元以内的设备可以直接订，不用额外审批。

situation.en: How do I order equipment, like a second monitor?
situation.zh: 你想再配一台显示器，先问问流程。

examples.en: He resigned to join a startup and left at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 他辞职去了一家创业公司，月底走的。

situation.en: Did you hear? Marco resigned last week.
situation.zh: 你跟朋友说起同事离职的事。

examples.en: My notice period is one month, so I can start in early January.
examples.zh: 我的离职通知期是一个月，所以一月初能入职。

situation.en: My notice period is one month, so the earliest I can start is January.
situation.zh: 面试时对方问你最快什么时候能入职，你要说清通知期。

entries.zh: 离职通知期、提前告知期

examples.en: She gave notice last week and finishes at the end of the month.
examples.zh: 她上周提出了离职，月底正式离开。

situation.en: I've decided to move on, so I'd like to give notice today.
situation.zh: 你决定换工作，在电话里正式向经理提出离职。

examples.en: HR scheduled an exit interview for my final week.
examples.zh: HR 把离职面谈安排在了我最后一周。

situation.en: What does the exit interview usually cover?
situation.zh: HR 发来邀请，你想确认离职面谈都聊些什么。

examples.en: My last day is Friday the 20th, and I'll return the laptop that morning.
examples.zh: 我最后一天是 20 号周五，那天上午我把笔记本还掉。

situation.en: Just a heads-up: my last day is Friday, so please loop Ana in after that.
situation.zh: 你在团队频道里跟大家告别，顺便说清最后一天是哪天。
